scope: Primary Linux physical validation target for issue #6. Prepared profiles only; no full-dataset run is claimed by this file.

platform.driver: inbox amdgpu (in-tree 6.17 OEM module); no amdgpu-dkms
platform.system_rocm_userland: 7.2.1 (untouched global; not used by the wheel runtime)
platform.matrix_reference: AMD ROCm docs-7.14.1 compatibility matrix, Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 family: Ubuntu 24.04.4 OEM kernel 6.17 supported

device.product: HP ZBook Ultra G1a 14 inch Mobile Workstation PC
device.cpu_model_name: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ PRO 395 w/ Radeon 8060S
device.memory: 96 GiB nominal system RAM; 32.0 GiB UMA dedicated carve-out; GTT up to 100 GiB; all GPU memory accounting is shared-system-memory, not dedicated VRAM
device.npu: aie2p RyzenAI-npu5 present; NOT used by the native Transformers stack

backend.decoder_attention: eager with original DASH sparse attention (12 DashAttention layers, Triton kernels, dense-prefill fallback refused)
backend.vision_attention: SDPBackend.MATH scoped to SAM and CLIP vision forwards (reviewed default; no AUTO switch)

policy_limits_unchanged.note: Production caps are NOT lifted by preparing these profiles. Long-document window/token policy is a separate reviewed change (docs/LONG_DOCUMENT_READINESS.md) that must pass physical gates before any >5-page or >8192-token benchmark run.

failure_accounting.denominator: all 420 MPDocBench documents / all 100 MarathonDocBench documents; failed documents never dropped
failure_accounting.per_document: raw output, finish reason, page counts, token counts, error class, retries preserved per ledger format
failure_accounting.truncation: finish_reason=length recorded as truncated, not silently retried to completion
failure_accounting.memory_latency: cold/warm model load, prefill/generation split, synchronized wall time, process RSS, GPU allocated/reserved/peak, per document and per page
failure_accounting.labels: APU shared-memory accounting; no dedicated-VRAM claims

blockers: backend: official customized SGLang vs native Transformers not yet demonstrated equivalent on HIP
preprocessing: complete local image archive (11 gated SlideVQA decks / 84 pages) and JPEG serialization reconciliation pending
token policy: long-document page-window and output-token policy not yet reviewed against the official one-request semantics
scoring methodology: FormulaCDM renderer closure (xelatex/TeX/fonts) unverified on this host; Overall aggregation remains null until all eight metrics run
